jobs.title: Hotel Manager
jobs.description: Lead the day-to-day operations of a premium 120-key resort in Goa. You will own guest experience, revenue performance, team leadership and operational standards across all departments. This is a hands-on leadership role for a hospitality professional who leads from the floor and builds high-performing teams.
responsibilities: Oversee daily operations across front office, F&B, housekeeping and engineering
Drive revenue, occupancy and guest satisfaction targets
Recruit, train and mentor department heads and team members
Maintain brand and service standards across the property
Manage budgets, P&L and cost controls
Ensure compliance with health, safety and licensing requirements
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Hotel Management or related field
5-8 years of progressive hospitality operations experience
Proven experience managing a full-service property
Strong commercial and people leadership skills
